job.title: QA Automation Engineer
job.description: Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts for web and mobile applications. Works closely with development teams to ensure product quality.
job.note: Requires hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.

job.title: Backend Developer
job.description: Designs and implements server-side logic, databases, and APIs to support frontend applications. Ensures scalability, security, and performance of backend systems.
job.note: Proficiency in Node.js, Java, or Python is preferred.

job.title: Frontend Developer
job.description: Builds responsive and interactive user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks. Collaborates with designers to translate UI/UX wireframes into functional code.
job.note: Experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js required.

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description: Manages CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployment automation. Works to improve system reliability, monitoring, and release processes.
job.note: Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS is a plus.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description: Gathers and documents business requirements, analyzes workflows, and bridges communication between stakeholders and the development team.
job.note: Strong communication and documentation skills required.

job.title: UI/UX Designer
job.description: Creates intuitive and visually appealing designs for web and mobile applications. Conducts user research and builds wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.
job.note: Proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD expected.

job.title: Project Coordinator
job.description: Assists project managers in planning, scheduling, and tracking project deliverables. Maintains documentation and coordinates communication between teams.
job.note: Familiarity with Jira and Agile methodology preferred.

job.title: Database Administrator
job.description: Manages database systems, ensures data integrity, performs backups, and optimizes query performance for large-scale applications.
job.note: Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB required.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description: Provides first and second-level support to customers, troubleshoots software issues, and escalates complex problems to engineering teams.
job.note: Good problem-solving and customer communication skills needed.

job.title: HR Executive
job.description: Handles recruitment, onboarding, employee records, and HR policy implementation. Supports payroll processing and employee engagement activities.
job.note: Experience with HRMS tools like OrangeHRM is beneficial.
